attchmntText: Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about unaudited financial results for the quarter, and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Bella Casa Fashion and Retail Limited, scrip code 539399, symbol BELLACASA, submitted newspaper clippings regarding the publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during its meeting held on November 05, 2026. The announcement was published in the Financial Express, an English newspaper, and Dainik Navjyoti, a Hindi newspaper, on November 07, 2026. This submission is made pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document was signed by Sonika Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A38676.

attchmntText: Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Press release on the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Bella Casa Fashion & Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release of the Company for receiving  MSME of the Year  award at the Financial Express Leadership Awards, held on November 02, 2026.'.
